text.p: IMC-Agrico Co said Friday it is temporarily suspending production at its Taft, La., plant, effective immediately.
The Taft plant has an annual capacity of one million tons of diammonium phosphate, a fertilizer.
IMC-Agrico is a joint venture partnership between IMC Global Inc and Freeport-McMoRan Resources Partners LP.

"A lull in domestic demand following an earlier-than-usual seasonal stocking of the nation's phosphate nutrient distribution system has led to our decision to reduce IMC-Agrico's output to avoid building costly inventories," Richard Block, president of the venture, said in a statement.
IMC-Agrico said it will continue to monitor closely concentrated phosphate consumption and adjust production accordingly.
